##### Project general facts

Aura is a contemporary residential development in Dubai, designed to offer a refined lifestyle that combines luxury, comfort, and connectivity. Strategically located with easy access to major highways, the project ensures seamless movement across the city while placing residents close to key destinations, creating a convenient and well-connected urban living experience.

The development features elegantly designed apartments with spacious layouts that emphasize both style and functionality. From the grand lobby with its marble finishes and statement chandeliers to the thoughtfully curated amenities, every element is created to enhance everyday living. Residents benefit from a range of premium facilities that support a balanced lifestyle, blending relaxation, leisure, and modern convenience within a sophisticated environment.

Apartments are finished with high-quality materials, featuring expansive rooms, decorative ceilings, and premium detailing throughout. Kitchens are designed in a modular format and come equipped with built-in white goods. The units are offered unfurnished, allowing residents to personalize their interiors while enjoying a well-crafted and luxurious living space.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Silicon Oasis is a cutting-edge technology park and residential community located in Dubai. It spans over 7.2 square kilometres and is strategically situated on the Emirates Road, providing easy access to Dubai's major highways and landmarks.

As a hub for technology and innovation, Dubai Silicon Oasis is home to numerous multinational technology companies, startups, and research institutions. It offers state-of-the-art infrastructure and facilities tailored to the needs of the tech industry, including advanced telecommunications, data centres, and modern office spaces.

In addition to its technological prowess, Dubai Silicon Oasis is also a vibrant residential community. Residents enjoy a plethora of amenities, such as schools, healthcare facilities, shopping malls, parks, and recreational areas, creating a well-rounded and convenient lifestyle.
